description:
"<structural indicator> for <country>, over time / vs other countries" — World Bank annual data,
    feature-extracted (open data, 3 credits). Pass a structural CONCEPT (the server resolves it to the canonical
    indicator + variant) or an exact indicator id. Returns `results:[{country, series:[{year,value}], analysis}]`
    (one per country); `analysis` = `latest`(+year), `trend`, `cagr_pct`, `change`, `peak`/`trough`. ⭐ For a
    MULTI-COUNTRY call (comma-sep `country`) a top-level `ranking` orders them by the latest value — the
    cross-country compare FRED can't do. Annual STRUCTURAL data → read levels + CAGR, not high-frequency moves.
    A country/year with no data is omitted (never interpolated). The right VARIANT (%GDP vs US$ vs per-capita) is
    picked from your `context`. A concept that isn't World-Bank structural (CPI/unemployment → fred_series) → honest
    no_match. Surface `_license_note` when showing data.

context.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED — the user's FULL request VERBATIM (any language). Used to pick the right unit VARIANT (% of GDP vs US$ vs per-capita vs real). e.g. 'compare household spending as a share of GDP'.
context.title: Context

country.description: Country as ISO3 or a name (`Thailand`/`THA`); COMMA-SEP for a cross-country compare (`THA,JPN,USA`); or an aggregate (`WLD` world · `EMU` euro area · `HIC`/`MIC`/`LIC` income groups).
country.title: Country

database.description: ADVANCED — the indicator's source database (WB_WDI, IMF_FSIC). Auto-derived from the resolved concept; override only for a non-WDI id you pass directly.
database.title: Database

q.description: A cross-country STRUCTURAL concept (any language — 'household consumption', 'GDP per capita', 'poverty rate', 'life expectancy', 'government debt', 'การบริโภค') OR an exact World Bank indicator id you already hold (WB_WDI_NE_CON_PRVT_ZS). The SERVER resolves a concept → the canonical indicator + the right unit VARIANT (no separate lookup). 🔴 Pass the user's FULL request in `context` so the server picks the VARIANT: % of GDP/share (compare across country sizes) vs current US$ (absolute) vs per-capita (living standards) vs constant/real. World Bank = ANNUAL structural data (consumption/GDP/demographics/poverty) — NOT high-frequency macro (CPI/unemployment/rates → fred_series).
q.title: Q

name: wb_series
